tasks.title: Pin all gem versions in Gemfile
tasks.description: Currently 24 gems are unpinned which risks breaking changes on bundle update. Add explicit version constraints (e.g., gem 'jekyll', '~> 4.3.4') for all gems in Gemfile based on current Gemfile.lock versions.

tasks.title: Fix exception handling in google-scholar-citations.rb
tasks.description: Replace 'rescue Exception => e' with 'rescue StandardError => e' at line 71. Also add granular handling for Net::OpenTimeout, Net::ReadTimeout, SocketError, and OpenURI::HTTPError with proper Jekyll.logger messages.

tasks.title: Add HTTParty timeout configuration
tasks.description: Add timeout: 10 to HTTParty.get calls in external-posts.rb (line 26, 89) and download-3rd-party.rb. Currently no timeout which can hang builds indefinitely.

tasks.title: Add basic plugin error logging
tasks.description: Replace puts statements with Jekyll.logger.warn/error in all plugins. Use proper log levels: warn for recoverable issues, error for failures. Files: google-scholar-citations.rb, external-posts.rb, inspirehep-citations.rb.

tasks.title: Extract shared GitHub icon include
tasks.description: Create _includes/github_icon.liquid to consolidate duplicated GitHub icon rendering from projects.liquid (lines 17-30) and projects_horizontal.liquid (lines 14-27). Pass project as parameter.

tasks.title: Group feature flags in _config.yml
tasks.description: Organize 15+ scattered enable_* flags into logical groups: analytics (google, cronitor, pirsch), features (darkmode, math, tooltips, masonry), social (navbar_social, project_categories). Add section comments.

tasks.title: Add plugin test framework
tasks.description: Set up RSpec or Minitest for _plugins/ directory. Create spec/plugins/ structure, add test helper with Jekyll site mock, write example test for one plugin. Zero test coverage currently.

tasks.title: Write tests for citation plugins
tasks.description: Add unit tests for google-scholar-citations.rb and inspirehep-citations.rb. Mock HTTP responses, test citation parsing, error handling, and caching behavior.

tasks.title: Merge project card templates
tasks.description: Consolidate projects.liquid and projects_horizontal.liquid into single template with layout parameter. Same for slides.liquid and slides_horizontal.liquid. Use {% assign layout = include.layout | default: 'vertical' %}.

tasks.title: Split musics.liquid into components
tasks.description: Break 642-line musics.liquid into focused includes: _includes/music/profile_card.liquid, _includes/music/player.liquid, _includes/music/list.liquid, _includes/music/pagination.liquid.

tasks.title: Split head.liquid into focused includes
tasks.description: Break 228-line head.liquid into: _includes/head/metadata.liquid, _includes/head/fonts.liquid, _includes/head/scripts.liquid, _includes/head/analytics.liquid. Improve maintainability.

tasks.title: Implement retry logic for external fetches
tasks.description: Add exponential backoff retry (max 3 attempts) for HTTParty calls in external-posts.rb and google-scholar-citations.rb. Handle transient network failures gracefully.

tasks.title: Fix thread-safety in google-scholar-citations.rb
tasks.description: Replace global mutable Citations = {} hash (line 11) with thread-safe implementation using Concurrent::Map or mutex protection.

tasks.title: Refactor bib.liquid into components
tasks.description: Break 369-line bib.liquid into: _includes/bib/author.liquid, _includes/bib/badges.liquid, _includes/bib/links.liquid. Reduce complexity from ~20 to ~10 per component.

tasks.title: Extract date badge rendering include
tasks.description: Create _includes/date_badge.liquid to consolidate duplicated date badge rendering from work.liquid and education.liquid resume templates.

tasks.title: Add CI quality gates for templates
tasks.description: Add GitHub Actions workflow to check: template line counts (max 300), no unpinned gems, required test coverage. Fail PR if thresholds exceeded.

tasks.title: Document asset optimization pipeline
tasks.description: Create docs/assets.md documenting: image optimization requirements, video compression strategy, font subsetting approach. Currently 126MB assets with no documentation.

tasks.title: Implement CSS purging in build
tasks.description: Configure purgecss to run automatically in production builds. Currently purgecss.config.js exists but isn't integrated into Jekyll build. Could reduce CSS by ~50%.

tasks.title: Audit and optimize font loading
tasks.description: Review 9.2MB font assets. Identify unused fonts, implement font subsetting for used fonts, add font-display: swap for better loading performance.

tasks.title: Add image optimization automation
tasks.description: Set up automated image optimization pipeline: resize large images, convert to WebP with fallbacks, implement lazy loading. Target: reduce 60MB img folder.

tasks.title: Refactor download-3rd-party.rb plugin
tasks.description: Reorganize 253-line plugin: extract helper methods into module, add proper error handling, improve URL validation beyond 'starts with |' check, add progress reporting.

tasks.title: Remove deprecated Disqus code
tasks.description: Delete disqus.liquid and remove disqus references from post.liquid (line 94). Config marks it deprecated but code remains. Clean dead code.

tasks.title: Validate external-posts.rb RSS parsing
tasks.description: Add validation for malformed RSS feeds in external-posts.rb. Handle empty entries, missing fields, invalid dates. Currently fails silently on bad feeds.

tasks.title: Consolidate slug generation in external-posts.rb
tasks.description: Refactor duplicated slug generation regex patterns (lines 46-53) into single reusable method. Three similar patterns currently exist.
